step1_analysis.description: A millimeter-wave VCO designed for wide tuning range and low phase noise. The extracted netlist appears to be the active core and biasing network of the VCO, containing BJTs, varactors (diodes), and resistors, but lacks the inductive elements (LC tank) necessary for oscillation, which were likely custom transmission lines or unextracted metal polygons.

paper_reference.title: Millimeter-Wave VCOs With Wide Tuning Range and Low Phase Noise, Fully Integrated in a SiGe Bipolar Production Technology

oscillation_frequency.description: The fundamental frequency of the oscillator.

sky130_expected.calculation: Without explicit inductors in the netlist, the circuit will not oscillate as an LC VCO. If it were a ring oscillator, frequency would depend on RC delays.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Missing LC tank components in the extracted netlist prevent oscillation.

phase_noise.description: Phase noise at 1-MHz offset from the carrier.

sky130_expected.reasoning: CMOS typically has worse phase noise than SiGe bipolar at mm-wave frequencies. Cannot be simulated without the resonator.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the circuit.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = VDD * I_total. Assuming 1.8V supply and ~10-20mA bias current.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled down for 1.8V CMOS/BiCMOS operation compared to the high-power mm-wave SiGe design.

tuning_range.description: Percentage variation in oscillation frequency over the tuning voltage range.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Varactor tuning range in standard CMOS is typically lower than specialized SiGe varactors.
Expected to be lower due to lower supply voltage (1.8V vs likely higher in original).

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power and attempt transient analysis. Note: Default values (1k, 1p) and generic models were added to the raw netlist to make it syntactically valid for SPICE.
step3_testbench.spice:
* VCO Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.model npn_model npn (is=1e-16 bf=100)
.model d_model D (is=1e-14)

Vvdd N0 0 1.8
Vtune LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9

* DUT with added default values for R and C to allow compilation
D1 N3 N0 d_model
R1 N6 N12 1k
R2 N1 N4 1k
D2 N9 N13 d_model
R3 N14 0 1k
R4 N6 N8 1k
R5 N5 0 1k
R6 N6 N7 1k
R7 N15 0 1k
Q1 N2 N2 N11 npn_model
Q2 N4 N2 N10 npn_model
D3 N7 N9 d_model
R8 N14 0 1k
R9 N6 0 1k
R10 N11 N13 1k
R11 N10 N13 1k
R12 N0 N15 1k
R13 N0 N13 1k
R14 N3 N4 1k
R15 N3 LABEL_NET_0 1k
R16 N1 N6 1k
R17 N2 0 1k
C1 N5 0 1p
Q3 N5 N12 N6 npn_model
Q4 N14 N8 LABEL_NET_0 npn_model
C2 N14 0 1p
D4 N1 N0 d_model
R18 N14 0 1k

.control
op
let power = -i(Vvdd)*1.8
print power

tran 10p 10n
meas tran v_max max v(N5)
meas tran v_min min v(N5)
let v_swing = v_max - v_min
print v_swing

* Attempt to measure frequency (will fail if no oscillation due to missing inductors)
meas tran t1 trig v(N5) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N5) val=0.9 rise=2
let freq = 1/t1
print freq
quit
.endc
